summary: Master health informatics and interoperability in 5 days. Build FHIR, HL7, and governance skills for better health data exchange. Enrol now.
lede: Health informatics and interoperability focuses on exchanging usable clinical data across systems and care workflows. For health IT, clinical systems and reporting professionals, this training supports interoperability delivery through data-quality assessment, terminology mapping and interface design informed by HL7 and FHIR. Learners also practice validating exchange, reviewing governance and consent controls, and building KPI dashboards to report performance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you work where clinical data, health IT, and reporting meet, and you need a practical understanding of standards, mappings, governance, and interoperability delivery.
audience: Quality Improvement Managers using interoperable data
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, familiarity with health data workflows, and the ability to review sample interface diagrams, mapping tables, and reporting extracts. No programming language is required, but you should be prepared to work with spreadsheets, digital templates, and standards-based examples during guided exercises.
